captions.ig:
Sent a quote and heard nothing? No reply is not always a no. People get busy.

The 3 follow ups, without being pushy:
Day 2: resend the job and price, offer one real time.
Day 5: ask if anything on the quote is unclear, or offer a smaller option.
Last one: close the loop and leave the door open.
Then stop. Two or three is plenty.

Sample business shown is made up.

Comment AGENTS and we will DM you the free starter: your first AI helper in 10 minutes. Works on the free Claude plan.
